description: Screening replay of the 4 Oct 2023 South Lhonak GLOF (Sikkim). The breach source is the moraine-dammed glacial lake, not an engineered dam; volume uses the ~58-65 Mm3 pre-event estimates (Sattar et al. 2021 / ISRO). Steep Himalayan terrain: treat 30 m DEM results as indicative only; the near-field is a DualSPHysics use case.
